title: Linework of one drawing: circles and closed outlines
description: Output of the read-only `harness geometry <work_dir> <file> [--sheet ID ...] [--bbox X0 Y0 X1 Y1] [--layer L ...] [--detail] [--max N] [--tol T] [--input-dir DIR]` (stdout, nothing written): the circles (piles) and closed outlines (pile caps, columns) of one drawing of a work folder, grouped by size per sheet (or per model-space region). Items: `circle` (a CIRCLE, a full ELLIPSE whose ratio is within 1e-6 of 1 such as a circle in a non-uniformly scaled INSERT, or a donut: a closed 2-vertex LWPOLYLINE whose two bulges are both +1 or both -1, centre = midpoint, diameter = vertex distance) and `outline` (a LWPOLYLINE or 2D POLYLINE with the closed flag, or without it when first and last vertex lie within tol); LINE, ARC, HATCH, other ELLIPSEs, SPLINEs and open polylines are only counted per layer. A closed-flag polyline loses its last vertex only when it repeats the first one (within 1e-9 of its size); spline-frame control vertices of a 2D POLYLINE are not points. An outline with a bulge is never a rectangle and its bbox follows the arcs. KNOWN GAP: an outline drawn as loose LINEs is not found. Identical items (same kind, effective layer, geometry rounded to tol) collapse into one with `copies`. All coordinates are world coordinates (mirrored INSERTs converted). Values are in the drawing's units as stored: nothing is converted (see `units`). Hidden entities are counted as `hidden` only: on an off or frozen layer, or drawn by an INSERT (at any depth) on a frozen layer (an off INSERT layer hides only its layer-0 content, which takes that layer). The invisible flag (group 60 = 1, own or of an INSERT above) hides nothing: the entity is counted normally and also in `invisible`; an item is invisible when all its copies are; a warning names the total. Placement: LINE by its midpoint, ARC by its mid-angle point, HATCH and SPLINE by the centre of their extents; one that has no extents is counted as `unplaced` in the null-sheet region.

file.description: Inventory path of the drawing, relative to the input folder.

sheet.description: Detector sheet ids asked for; null = every sheet (or the bbox).

bbox.description: Model-space region (x0, y0, x1, y1); never together with sheet.

layer.description: Effective-layer filter, case-insensitive; null = every layer.

max.description: Cap on groups per region and on items per region; null = defaults (40 groups, 500 items).

tol.description: Dedupe and rounding tolerance in drawing units, as used: the --tol value, else 1 mm in the answered unit, else in the declared unit, else 1.0 (with a warning).

declared.description: The unit the header declares ($INSUNITS, as the probe reports it); null when none.

answered.description: The unit of the file's active units_confirm_all answer; null when not answered.

converted.description: Always false: every value is as stored in the drawing.

regions.description: One entry per requested sheet (in the order asked), the bbox region, or every non-empty sheet plus a null-sheet region for items on no sheet.

ellipses.description: ELLIPSEs that are not a full circle (a ratio-1 ellipse is a circle, or an arc when partial).

hidden.description: Entities on this layer that are not drawn: the layer is off or frozen, or an INSERT above it is on a frozen layer (counted in no other field).

invisible.description: Entities carrying the invisible flag (group 60), own or of an INSERT above, that are also counted in their kind; copies included.

unplaced.description: HATCHes and SPLINEs without extents: no position, so on no sheet (counted in no other field).

copies_collapsed.description: Extra identical circles / outlines folded into a unique item.

copies.description: Circles drawn (unique items with their copies).

invisible.description: Unique items that carry the invisible flag (all their copies do).

centre_bbox.description: Bounding box of the item centres.

short.description: Rounded to tol (short side; bounding-box side for a non-rectangle, the bbox follows arc segments).

invisible.description: Unique items that carry the invisible flag (all their copies do).

item_id.description: Stable item id: first 10 hex of sha1 of space|kind|layer|rounded geometry. Shared with `harness contents`.

space.description: The space the item is drawn in, as the text index names it: `model`, or a layout name. An item seen through a viewport stays in `model`, in world coordinates.

sheet.description: Detector sheet of the centre as `SheetLocator.locate` gives it (the first sheet frame in detector order that holds the point); null when no frame holds it.

centre.description: Circle centre, or the bounding-box centre of an outline (world coordinates).

short.description: Outlines only: short side of a rectangle, else bounding-box side.

angle.description: Rectangles only: direction of the long side in degrees, [0, 180).

rectangle.description: Outlines only: 4 vertices with right angles within 0.5 degree and no arc segment.

points.description: Non-rectangle outlines only: the vertices (at most 64).

copies.description: How many identical items were drawn.

invisible.description: Every copy carries the invisible flag (group 60), own or of an INSERT above.

top_handle.description: Handle of the top-level entity it came through; null when handles are unreliable.

block_path.description: Blocks entered, outermost first; empty at top level.

sheet.description: Detector sheet id; null for the bbox region and for items on no sheet.
